category_title: At-risk students balancing full-time employment and parental responsibilities
scenario_title: Disengagement with Novanet online instructional program
minimal_context: The student is logging into the Novanet online instructional program to complete a self-paced lesson during their short school schedule.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please log into the Novanet online instructional program and continue your self-paced lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I only have my short 4-hour school schedule today. Do I really have to spend it on Novanet?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Yes, please go ahead and start the module.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm clicking through it, but I do not seem to learn from the online lessons.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep reading through the screens and try your best.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I strongly feel that the program is boring. I'm expressing my discontent because I'm not learning anything, and I'm already frustrated by the delay in my class schedule changes.
